cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Welcome to our inn. Please apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Explain that you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for telling the telephone first. It had to hear about its own visitor secondhand.

mechanism: A welcomes a guest and permits entry while coaxing apologies for impossible advance notice and notifying the wrong object first.
confusable: Unlike complaining about a rude guest, the doorway itself expects impossible knuckle notice and priority over the telephone.
comparison: Inn check-in and luggage help differ from a caretaker interview and standing.
seedUse: D147-b doorway knock and telephone priority; S02-b adjusts practical hosting to preserve compliance.
